items.question: Does the Kestrel storage agreement have a fixed end date?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement does not have a fixed end date. Instead, it continues until terminated, as stated in the agreement: "This Agreement continues until terminated" [1]. Additionally, either party may terminate the agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice [1].

There is no mention of a fixed end date in the amendment to the agreement either. The amendment only modifies the monthly storage fee and the effective date of the change [2].

evidence.quote: This Agreement continues until terminated
Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice
This Amendment takes effect on 1 June 2026
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: Which terms of the storage agreement remain in force after Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that after Amendment No. 1, all other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force. Specifically, the amendment states: "All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force" [1].

This means that the original terms of the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement, except for the amended clause (3.1), continue to be valid. These include, but are not limited to, the services provided, the term and termination provisions, and the liability limits. For example, the original agreement states: "This Agreement continues until terminated" [3], and "Provider's total liability for loss of or damage to stored goods is limited to EUR 150,000 per event" [3].

Additionally, other agreements referenced in the documents, such as the Northbridge NDA, Harrowgate MSA, and Unit 7 Lease, are not amended by Amendment No. 1 and thus their terms remain in effect as originally stated. For instance, the Northbridge NDA specifies that "The obligations in Clause 3 continue for five (5) years after this Agreement ends" [2].

evidence.quote: All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force.
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

evidence.quote: This Agreement continues until terminated.
Provider's total liability for loss of or damage to stored goods is limited to EUR 150,000 per event.
The obligations in Clause 3 continue for five (5) years after this Agreement ends.
